mentions.name: Personal life everything app
mentions.description: This app is an all-in-one personal life manager combining todos, calendar with Google and Garmin integration, habits, long-term goals, meals, family leaderboards, notifications, markdown-exportable notes, and finances (account balances, transactions, investments). It also offers shopping lists with scannable receipts, a quick inbox that converts random ideas into tasks/goals/habits/notes, weekly reviews, morning manifestos, and AI-powered daily recaps. It is self-hosted on a NAS and styled like a commercial SaaS.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An everything app for personal life. 
Todos, Calendar with google, garmin integration, habits, long term goals, meals, leaderboards (within family), notifications, notes (md exportable), finances (account balances, transactions, investments), shopping lists with scannable receipts, quick inbox for random ideas which then are converted into tasks/goals/habits/notes, weekly reviews, morning manifestos and more.

70k LOC. Deployed on Nas. Superpowered with AI for daily recaps.
